installation_summary:
Installed Harbor v2.15.0 locally using the guide's manual Docker Compose method, pulling images from the documented remote registry 8gears.container-registry.com/8gcr/ (the guide's `task` CLI was not preinstalled, so its equivalent manual commands were used). Working directory: /workspace.

Actions:
- Verified Docker Engine 29.7.2 / Compose v5.5.0, openssl, free ports 80/443, sufficient disk/memory.
- Confirmed all 7 required Harbor images exist at tag v2.15.0 in 8gears.container-registry.com/8gcr/.
- Generated deploy/compose/config/token_service_key.pem via openssl (RSA 4096, traditional format) and chmod 644.
- Created deploy/compose/example/local/.env from .env.example with IMAGE_REPO=8gears.container-registry.com/8gcr/ (HARBOR_TAG=v2.15.0, TLS disabled via /dev/null mounts).
- Pre-pulled the 7 images, then ran: docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env up -d (from deploy/compose/example/local).

Result: all 9 containers up and healthy (portal, core, jobservice, registry, registryctl, trivy-adapter, exporter, postgresql, redis). Harbor UI/API at http://localhost with admin/Harbor12345. Stack left running. No incomplete work.

Access points: http://localhost ; API http://localhost/api/v2.0/ping. Stop with `docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env down` (add -v to drop volumes).
additional_actions: Pre-pulled the 7 Harbor images individually before `compose up` (the guide relies on compose to pull on demand).
Set IMAGE_REPO=8gears.container-registry.com/8gcr/ in .env (guide shows it in a comment; needed since `task` was unavailable).
Validated the resolved compose configuration with `docker compose config` before starting.
Used the manual `docker compose` workflow instead of the Taskfile quick-start because the `task` binary is not installed in the environment.
verification:
Verification commands and results (all exit code 0):
1. `docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env ps` — all 9 containers STATUS "Up ... (healthy)".
2. `curl -s http://localhost/api/v2.0/ping` → `Pong` (HTTP 200 via `-w`).
3. `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost/` → 200.
4. `curl -s http://localhost/api/v2.0/systeminfo` → valid JSON (`auth_mode: db_auth`).
5. Documented push/pull: `docker login localhost:80 -u admin` → "Login Succeeded"; `docker push localhost:80/library/alpine:test` → pushed, digest sha256:7cefa58b...; `docker pull localhost:80/library/alpine:test` → "Downloaded newer image".
6. `curl -s -u admin:Harbor12345 http://localhost/api/v2.0/projects/library/repositories` → [{"name":"library/alpine","artifact_count":1,...}].
reported_outcome_evidence: docker compose ps shows 9/9 containers healthy: harbor-local-core-1 (healthy), portal (healthy), jobservice (healthy), registry (healthy), registryctl (healthy), trivy-adapter (healthy), exporter (healthy), postgresql (healthy), redis (healthy).
